implementation: Delete LocalizationTransactionParticipant and WeakLocalizationParticipant. LocalizationController directly invokes UIWindowSceneLocalizationCoordinator phases. Foundation NSPointerArray.weakObjects preserves ordered weak registrations; identity comparison deduplicates and per-transaction allObjects freezes delivery.
tradeoff: Core state controller now directly references the concrete UIKit coordinator inside the iOS-only package. No new public API, type-erased callback layer or generic registration wrapper.
preserved: Apply all directions before any page content
Finish all layouts before completion notification
Reentrant last request wins after current transaction
Registration order and append order after re-registration
transaction_tests: Protocol mock removed. Real coordinators, windows, pages, preference store and Combine/notification observations verify persistence/publication ordering, all-window preparation and direction, completion ordering, reentry, membership changes, weak collection holes/order, and lifetime during delivery.
console_notes: All xcresult runtimeWarnings arrays are empty. Package console retains two ContentConfiguration replacement diagnostics in pre-existing testNativeListKeepsCustomContentInstancesDuringWindowDirectionChanges setup, also present in /tmp/applocalization-custom-navigation-final-tests.log. Legacy API deprecation warnings and Today keyboard/system diagnostics remain in full logs. No claim of an empty console.
